_comment: Compact source spec for the progression. tools/generate_data.py expands this into data/{tiers,items,machines,recipes,techs}.json. Edit THIS file, never the generated output.
_forms_comment: Form ladder. Each material declares which forms it has; the generator emits the shaping recipe for each.
_components_comment: Emitted for every tier that declares the component. {metal}/{insulator}/{wire_metal}/{magnet_metal} resolve per tier.
_machines_comment: A machine category exists at each tier listed. Its craft recipe is hull + (circuits+cables when the tier has electronics) + the parts below.
_chemistry_comment: Hand-written recipes that do not fit a generated pattern. These are the real tier gates.
_techs_comment: Four tech lines run the length of the ladder. Each tier's metallurgy node is gated on physically holding that tier's machine hull, which is what makes progression component-gated rather than points-gated.
